reason: AZZ provides hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating services to fabricators, utilities and infrastructure contractors, earning service fees and coated-coil sales. Eastern designs and manufactures engineered hardware (latches, hinges, locks), returnable packaging, mold tools and truck mirrors and vision systems, sold to vehicle and industrial OEMs. The products differ, the customer bases barely overlap, and Eastern earns money from product sales rather than coating services.
